themes.description: Users report that the app is leaking personal and banking data, enabling fraud calls, sharing contact details with third parties, and using data without consent, leading to distrust and perceived fraudulent behavior.
themes.business_impact: Loss of user trust, increased uninstall rates, potential regulatory fines, and damage to brand reputation; could lead to legal liabilities and loss of partnership opportunities.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app’s data handling and consent management may be insufficiently secured or compliant, allowing third‑party access; possibly insufficient encryption, weak privacy policy enforcement, and inadequate monitoring of data sharing.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit and strengthen data handling & privacy policies; implement end‑to‑end encryption for sensitive data
• Review third‑party integrations to ensure no unauthorized data sharing
• Enhance consent flow with clear opt‑in/out and granular permissions
• Conduct security penetration testing & fix vulnerabilities
• Update privacy policy and communicate changes transparently
• Set up dedicated fraud monitoring & incident response team
• Provide transparent customer support with verified contacts
• Train staff on privacy compliance

this app is showing wrong conversion rate in us stocks and last 2 week it's shows wrong value. very worst app.

themes.description: Users report that limit and GTT orders are being executed at incorrect prices, or orders are being filled at prices below their target. They also complain about delayed or inaccurate portfolio valuations and misleading conversion rates, leading to financial losses.
themes.business_impact: Direct monetary loss for traders, erosion of trust in the trading platform, increased support tickets and potential churn among high‑frequency users who rely on precise order execution.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Recent UI and backend refactoring introduced a mismatch between the order‑creation parameters and the routing engine, causing price thresholds to be ignored or misinterpreted. Additionally, the price‑feed integration for US stocks was altered without adequate regression testing, leading to stale or incorrect pricing data.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Revert UI changes to the previous stable release to restore correct order parameter handling
• 2. Implement a comprehensive test suite for order routing, covering limit and GTT orders with edge‑case prices
• 3. Deploy a monitoring alert for discrepancies between intended and executed order prices
• 4. Roll out a data‑validation layer that checks real‑time price feeds against the order price before execution
• 5. Communicate a clear apology and immediate refund policy for affected users
• 6. Schedule a post‑deployment audit of conversion rate APIs and fix any drift in rates

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that support tickets take months, offer no resolution, and that there is no accessible phone support or effective chatbot. These frustrations result in missed trades, account deletions, and a perception of the platform as unreliable.
themes.business_impact: Account churn spikes as users delete accounts; missed trading opportunities directly reduce revenue; brand reputation suffers from negative word‑of‑mouth, leading to slower user acquisition and higher acquisition costs.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support system is understaffed and lacks defined escalation paths; current ticketing workflow is manual and slow, while the chatbot is unconfigured and provides generic responses. NRI KYC support is particularly deficient due to specialized knowledge requirements that are not met.
themes.action_plan:
• Build a dedicated support queue with assigned agents
• Implement SLA metrics for response and resolution times
• Provide a toll‑free phone line and schedule live chat hours
• Train support staff on NRI KYC procedures and common issues
• Integrate knowledge base into chatbot for accurate answers
• Deploy a ticketing dashboard for monitoring and reporting
• Conduct quarterly reviews of support metrics and user feedback
• Release incremental improvements to chatbot logic
